label: WRONG
reason: Auth and team membership are enforced globally (main.ts useGlobalGuards(JwtAuthGuard, TeamAccessGuard, UuidValidationGuard)); the class-level UseGuards (NodeTeamAccessGuard, VersionTeamAccessGuard) only check that a path resource id belongs to the team. The outliers are controllers with no such resource id (audit, dashboard by teamSlug only), public or global routes (health, quality-assurance, templates) and users/me routes scoped to the caller's identity, so nothing extra is at stake (R3) and new such controllers would be false alarms.
